notes: route: 14_global_military [V16-B2a] Rich trained under Carl W. Hughes during his surgical internship at Tripler General Hospital, Honolulu (1960-1961) and his general surgery residency at Letterman General Hospital, San Francisco (1961-1965). Hughes held a documented Chief, General Surgical Service / Assistant Chief of Surgery title at Tripler during Rich's internship, satisfying the structural-role bar. [Verified 2026-07-18 | Scand J Surg 2002;91:109-126, Rich autobiographical review | content_match] Rich names Hughes as his teacher across the internship and residency years in the first person. Hughes was himself the Korean-War vascular-repair pioneer (Walter Reed peripheral vascular center) and later supported Rich's Vietnam Vascular Registry. Upstream Holman->Hughes mentorship (Halsted-Holman legacy, PMID 20670783) is documented as encouragement/legacy, not a formal PD/APD relationship, and is HELD pending structural-title sourcing per scope bar; thus this edge does not by itself place Rich on the Halsted trunk.
